text:
### Right to Portability
**Customer Request:** "Give me my data in a portable format"
**Your Action:**
- Acknowledge request
- Send to DPO
- DPO provides structured, commonly used format (PDF, CSV, etc.)
name: Chunk 24/61

raw_entities.name: Right to Portability Request Acknowledgement
raw_entities.description: Staff must acknowledge a customer's request for their data in a portable format and escalate to the Data Protection Officer. This is a mandatory GDPR compliance duty triggered by explicit customer request for data portability.
context: Give me my data in a portable format

raw_entities.name: Data Portability Format Provision
raw_entities.description: The Data Protection Officer must provide customer data in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format such as PDF or CSV in response to a portability request. This fulfils the GDPR right to data portability requirement.
context: DPO provides structured, commonly used format (PDF, CSV, etc.)
Give me my data in a portable format

raw_entities.name: Data Portability Request Escalation to DPO
raw_entities.description: All customer requests for data portability must be escalated to the Data Protection Officer for processing and response. This ensures centralised, compliant handling of GDPR data portability rights.
context: DPO provides structured, commonly used format (PDF, CSV, etc.)

raw_entities.name: Customer Requesting Data Portability
raw_entities.description: A customer exercising their GDPR right to data portability by requesting their personal data in a portable, machine-readable format. This customer initiates the portability request process.
context: Customer Request: 'Give me my data in a portable format'
